thread:
Alex H: Quick async — milestone wedge 3 check. TL;DR: routing rollout shipped to staging, billing integration slipped. Need owners for a couple deps.

Maya R: Thanks. Can we get a short owner/deps list? I can triage PRs tomorrow.

Samir P: Owner for routing rollout: Samir + eng-runtime. Shipped staging deploy earlier: deploy-bot reported success. Prod rollout planned after canary metrics.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-service v2.3.1 deployed to staging (3182468205) :white_check_mark:

Ingrid T: Billing integration (payments adapter) slipped because of flaky test suite and third-party sandbox downtime. Current ETA +1 sprint. Owner: Ingrid + payments infra.

Luis C: @Ingrid T can you list which sandbox endpoints are flaky? I can reach out to partner contact.

Ingrid T: Sandbox endpoints: /transactions/simulate, /webhook/test. Logs show 503 spikes. I'll paste failing logs tomorrow.

Alex H: Ok — proposed next steps: 1) Samir: run canary for 48h and post latency/cost dashboard. 2) Ingrid: confirm partner contact + test matrix by EOD Fri. 3) Maya: prioritize two CRs blocking billing adapter (PR #5123, #5131). 4) Luis: try partner contact and report.

Samir P: Will run canary starting now. I'll post a short dashboard link once I have 2hrs of data.

Maya R: Re: CRs — pinged authors to rebase. Quick request: can reviewers prioritize? These CRs block A/B experiments for next week.

Alex H: Who can review #5123? @Samir P? @Luis C?

Luis C: I'll take #5123 tonight, aim to merge by tomorrow morning.

Samir P: I'll take #5131, but I might need a small follow-up from infra.

ci-bot: [ci] PR #5123 passed CI on branch feature/billing-adapter (3182468580)

Maya R: Nice. Also note risk: if billing adapter slips, product will hold off payment-related UX test. We should flag to PMs.

Alex H: I'll update product PMs. @Maya R can you list the tests that get blocked? Keep it terse.

Maya R: Blocked tests: 'checkout flow - success', 'retry on transient failure', and 'webhook handling end-to-end'.

Alex H: Thanks. Last item — dependency tracker. I've added a small table in the milestone doc and assigned owners. Link: https://redwood.internal/s/milestone-w3 (will grant access to folks who don't have it). If you need access ping me.

Ingrid T: Access requested. Also +1 for partner outreach, Luis — appreciate it.

Luis C: Reached out to partner support, waiting for confirmation. Will escalate if no reply in 24h.

Alex H: Great. We'll reconvene async — update the milestone doc when any change occurs. If anything is high-risk, @channel call it out with :rotating_light:. Thanks all.

Maya R: Adding a short backlog ticket for contingency plan (feature flag rollback) — @Samir P can you estimate effort? 1-2 devs, 3 days? 

Samir P: Estimate: 2 devs, ~2.5 days to add safe rollback path and test matrix.

Alex H: Noted. Closing the async check. If no objections, we'll follow this plan and track in the milestone doc.

Luis C: No objections. I'll follow up on partner.

Ingrid T: No objections.

Maya R: No objections. :thumbsup:
